EA-298.family: Ambiguity Tolerance — Optionality, Experimentation & Calm Under Uncertainty
EA-298.theme: Clarity is earned inside uncertainty: decide with ~60% information, run small bets, update fast.

EA-299.family: Letting Go — Closure, Release & Forward Momentum
EA-299.theme: Progress accelerates when you release what no longer serves—close loops, return weight, and step lighter.

EA-300.theme: Integrity scales when values decide your calendar—align identity, habits, and choices so effort compounds cleanly.

EA-301.theme: Write your rules, then let them rule—codified principles turn chaos into a compass under pressure.

EA-302.theme: Flow isn’t an accident—it’s engineered: design the triggers, guard the time, and ride the current until the work starts working on you.

EA-303.family: Intuition — Subconscious, Pattern Sense & Symbolic Insight
EA-303.theme: When reason reaches its shoreline, intuition sails on—quiet the surface, read the depths, and let symbols steer the course.

EA-304.theme: Progress that survives pressure: anchor habits, stack small wins, and fortify the base before you raise the tower.

EA-305.theme: When clarity fractures, come back to the body—see, hear, feel, smell, taste—anchor attention and let coherence rebuild from the present moment out.

EA-306.theme: Influence scales from the inside out: align breath and body, then project warm strength that steadies rooms and uplifts people.

EA-307.theme: Teams move like one organism when trust, timing, and shared intent lock into cadence.

EA-308.theme: Adversity becomes compost for the soul; presence, purpose, and letting go turn pressure into renewal.

EA-309.theme: In the deepest dark, bonded hearts braid strength—support becomes the rope that lifts everyone out.

EA-310.theme: When the fall is studied, it becomes footing. Failure, faced cleanly, converts into fuel for the next ascent.

EA-311.theme: Power becomes real when you move. Decisive steps convert earned insight into visible change.

EA-312.theme: After the peak, power is tempered by processing—naming the cost, integrating the change, and choosing how to re-enter.

EA-313.theme: When the boon is secured, leadership is choosing a vector, communicating it crisply, and owning the consequences.

EA-314.theme: Under pressure, clarity is earned: gather just enough truth, align to your highest aim, commit, and move.

EA-315.theme: Pause, breathe, and honor the ground gained—gratitude locks in growth and steadies the return.

EA-316.theme: A vivid, shared picture of the future pulls allies into formation and turns scattered effort into one coordinated rescue.

EA-317.family: Release — Letting Go, Surrender & Radical Trust
EA-317.theme: When the old grip finally loosens, space appears for rescue, renewal, and solutions you could never have muscled into existence.

EA-318.theme: When awareness stops being a spotlight on the self and becomes a lantern for everyone, decisions shift from survival to stewardship.

EA-319.theme: Real competition is not against other people, but against the ceilings that keep potential small.

EA-320.theme: When mastery matures, the real question becomes not ‘How high did I climb?’ but ‘Who is safer, stronger, and freer because I was here?’

EA-321.theme: Before anything can be healed, moved, or elevated, it has to be seen as it truly is—no filters, no faking, just clear, grounded noticing.

EA-322.theme: When the old structure finally breaks, it doesn’t mean the story is over—it means the real story can finally begin.

EA-323.theme: Before the universe asks more of you, you must decide how you deserve to be treated—by others, and by yourself.

EA-324.theme: When the universe calls you forward, the first brave response isn’t a dramatic leap—it’s a disciplined season of learning that keeps you from burning out mid-journey.

EA-325.theme: When the final decision arrives, true leadership isn’t loud domination—it’s quiet, unshakeable resolve that treats every being with dignity while still saying a clear, costly yes.

EA-326.theme: Real strength isn’t the absence of struggle—it is the courage to walk through conflict, grief, and change with an open heart, and to turn shared pain into shared healing.

EA-327.display_name: The Steady Heart in the Storm
EA-327.theme: In the middle of chaos, true power is the calm, benevolent presence that refuses to abandon empathy—even when everything else is falling apart.

EA-328.theme: Your curiosity is not random wandering—it’s a disciplined quest to test ideas, reveal truth, and stand for what you can live with in the light.

EA-329.family: Resilience — Strength Forged Through Repeated Trials
EA-329.theme: Your victories are not lucky breaks—they are the visible scar tissue of every time you refused to stay down.

EA-330.family: Restoration — Strength Regained Through Intentional Recovery
EA-330.theme: Your capacity to recover is not wasted time; it is the hidden infrastructure that keeps your purpose from collapsing under pressure.

EA-331.display_name: The Creative Conductor of Cosmic Harmony
EA-331.family: Innovation — Emotionally-Driven Creative Problem Solving Under Pressure
EA-331.theme: Your emotions are not interruptions to problem-solving—they’re the signal fire that turns pressure into original solutions no one else can see.

EA-332.display_name: The Apex Mind of Living Strategy
EA-332.family: Strategic Thinking — Apex-Level Clarity and Deliberate Insight
EA-332.theme: Your clearest power emerges when you rise above the noise, see the pattern as a whole, and choose with deliberate precision.

EA-333.family: Commencement — Answering the Call and Unifying the Tribe Around Shared Purpose
EA-333.theme: Your life changes most profoundly the moment you stop waiting for permission and step forward as the one who calls the tribe into its next era.

EA-334.display_name: The Great One of the Night of Sorrow
EA-334.family: Emotional Depth — Finding Meaning, Strength, and Revelation in Sorrow
EA-334.theme: When you stop outrunning grief and sit beside it, sorrow turns from a weight you drag into a compass pointing toward what mattered most all along.

EA-335.display_name: The Prosperous Architect of the New Realm
EA-335.family: Abundance — Prosperity Built Through Intentional Design
EA-335.theme: Real prosperity is not what you accumulate for yourself, but the world you design so that growth becomes possible for everyone.

EA-336.display_name: The Paradigm-Breaking King of Creative Force
EA-336.family: Innovation Energy — Playful Power to Rewrite Reality
EA-336.theme: Your creativity is not just for making new things—it is the quiet revolution that takes apart what no longer deserves to rule you.

EA-337.display_name: The Sunglow Guardian of Intrinsic Worth
EA-337.family: Resilience Development — Learning to Stay with Yourself When Your Effort Wavers
EA-337.theme: Your worth is not as unstable as your effort—real resilience begins when you stop measuring your value by how perfectly you perform.

EA-338.display_name: The Clear-Eyed Heir of Respectful Authority
EA-338.family: Critical Reflection — Seeing Through Illusions of Approval and Power
EA-338.theme: Not every victory is real, and not every failure is loss; true success is measured by integrity, respect, and alignment with what actually works.

EA-339.display_name: The Alchemist of Fear and Creative Tension
EA-339.family: Emotional Intelligence — Fear as Signal, Conflict as Creative Force
EA-339.theme: Courage isn’t the absence of fear; it’s learning to listen to it, stand inside it, and transform conflict into forward motion instead of retreat.

EA-340.display_name: The Hearthkeeper in the Cosmic Storm
EA-340.theme: Peace is not the absence of crisis, but the presence of people who choose to keep the hearth warm while the universe shudders outside.

EA-341.family: Trust — Reliability Proven Through Shared Trials
EA-341.theme: Real trust isn’t built when everything works; it’s forged when you keep showing up after things fall apart.

EA-342.family: Collective Creativity — Excellence Forged Through Shared Insight
EA-342.theme: Your highest level isn’t reached alone; it’s unlocked when your best ideas ignite someone else’s, and theirs ignite yours.

EA-343.display_name: The Unbreakable Engine of Creative Strength
EA-343.family: Great Strength — Endurance, Purpose, and Structured Creativity Under Maximum Pressure
EA-343.theme: Your true strength is not proven by how hard you push once, but by how creatively you keep advancing when every part of you wants to stop.

EA-344.display_name: The Ember Knight of Inner Empowerment
EA-344.family: Empowerment — Rising from Ultimate Despair into Disciplined Inner Strength
EA-344.theme: Your lowest moment is not the proof that you’re finished—it’s the forge where your next, truer self is hammered into being.

EA-345.family: Direct Communication — Truth-Telling in High-Stakes Moments

EA-346.display_name: The White Comet of Swift Resolution
EA-346.family: Expeditious Action — Rapid Execution in Sacred Turning Points
EA-346.theme: At the edge of collapse, speed without clarity causes chaos—but when you know exactly what must be done and move on it immediately, you can save in minutes what negligence has been eroding for ages.

EA-347.family: Agile Synchronization — Harmonizing Speed, Structure, and Team Flow
EA-347.theme: When everything is on the line, speed alone is chaos—but when clear roles, clean flow, and shared focus align, a team can move so quickly and coherently it feels like one mind in many bodies.

EA-348.display_name: The Heart of the Unified Host
EA-348.family: Spiritual Cohesion — Shared Soul in the Midst of Trial
EA-348.theme: When the night is deepest, you don’t survive by being the strongest alone—you survive by remembering that you were never meant to stand alone at all.

EA-349.family: Steady Navigation — Direction Rooted in Relationship Under Pressure
EA-349.theme: When the path disappears, you don’t need perfect clarity—you need a true heading and people you trust enough to walk beside you.

EA-350.family: Threshold Energy — Anxiety and Excitement at the Edge of Transformation
EA-350.theme: On the brink of everything changing, your racing heart isn’t a warning to retreat—it’s proof you’re alive enough to step through.

EA-351.family: Equilibrium Energy — Vulnerability, Adaptability, and Inner Balance in Motion
EA-351.theme: Real power within is not rigid control; it’s the ability to stay grounded and honest while everything around you moves.

EA-352.family: Emotional Gravity Field — Interconnection, Distress Management, and Stabilizing Presence
EA-352.theme: True emotional power emerges when you can feel everything that’s happening in the field—and still choose to be a steady, unshakable point of calm.

EA-353.family: Stewardship Current — Wealth, Responsibility, and Decisive Governance of Value
EA-353.theme: Real security is not the absence of risk, but the ability to make clear, principled decisions about resources in a way that protects, nourishes, and guides the future.

EA-354.family: Memory Currents — Reflection, Narrative Integration, and Choice Wisdom
EA-354.theme: Your past is not a prison or a shrine; it’s a living archive of experience that, when viewed clearly, can guide you toward wiser choices in the present.

EA-355.family: Achievement Currents — Mastery, Flow, and Sustained Excellence Over Time
EA-355.theme: True success is not a single spike of glory; it is the quiet, disciplined art of sustaining excellence without losing your joy, your relationships, or yourself.

EA-356.family: Liberation Currents — Vision, Inner Freedom, and Blueprinted Paths Beyond Constraint
EA-356.theme: Real freedom doesn’t always begin with escape; it begins when you can see clearly inside the cage and still design the path beyond it.

EA-357.family: Transitional Sovereignty — Leadership, Letting Go, and Guiding the Final Passage
EA-357.theme: At the true end of a cycle, leadership isn’t just about holding the line—it’s about knowing what to release so that something greater can live.

EA-358.family: World-Bridging Vector — Curiosity, Mapping, and Rescue from Beyond
EA-358.theme: Real exploration is not escape from the world but a brave expansion of it—walking beyond the known so that others can one day follow safely.

EA-359.family: Dual Horizon Intelligence — Knowledge, Strategy, and Collaborative Competition Across Timelines
EA-359.theme: True knowledge is the ability to hold multiple realities in mind at once—and choose actions that turn conflict into cooperative evolution.

EA-360.family: Crowned Unity — Mastery, Meaning, and Service Between Worlds
EA-360.theme: Real mastery is not escaping into the higher world or surrendering to the old one; it is learning to stand in both at once, carrying meaning between them.
